discussion.body: SET-1.3 Bring work in — impl status: mostly built, not done (gate SET-1.2; crop is numeric only). Images, SVG, DXF import. DWG shows a stub (save as DXF). Assets drawer. Import inspector: role, replace, detach, relink, flip, rotate 90, fit, usage, versions, crop x/y/w/h fields. Missing vs exit: no in-canvas crop drag; crop is numbers in the inspector. Y-up flip is only at the screen transform. How to verify: drop SVG or DXF, place, export, confirm it did not flip twice. Gate SET-1.2 is not done.
